title: Rebound Life
description: - Silent Life and Clock Life but reversed!
body:
# **Rebound Life!!!**
Hello Viewers And Welcome To **Rebound Life,** This is A Twist That Combines Two Twists, Those Being **Clock Life, And Silent Life, but it flips it upside down.**





## **Core Twist: (Reverse Clock Life)**
- **You Will Be granted 7 Lives, 1 Heart, And A Timer**
- **Each Time The Timer Goes to 0:00, Or You Die, You Gain Two Hearts**
- **Each time you gain a Kill you lose a heart.**
- **Going above 10 hearts removes a life while Going Under 1 Heart Gives you a life!**
___________________________________________________________

## **Kill Rule:**
**7 Lives Is Aqua - Aqua Can Not Kill Anyone - 30 Mins Timer**

**6 Lives is Blue - Blue Can Not Kill Anyone - 35 Min Timer**

**5 Lives is Dark Green -They Can Kill Aqua - 40 Min Timer**
 
**4 Lives Is Green - They Can Kill Blue and Aqua  - 45 Min Timer**

**3 Lives Is Yellow - They Can kill anyone who has more than 4 lives - 50 Min Timer**

**2 Lives Is Orange - They Can Kill Anyone Besides Oranges and Reds - 55 Min Timer**

**1 Lives Is Red - They Can Kill ALL!!! - 60 Min Timer**

**0 Lives Is Out** - Ermm Wompity Womp - 65 min Timer ig tho
_________________________________________________
## **The Boogey:**

It is Now Called The Broken, To Cure or To be Stable you need a Kill! **(There Can be 1-3 Broken)**
**Every Hour This Role Will Fail, And be rerolled! X:00**

Killing as Broken: **-2 Hearts**
Dying to a Broken: **+4 Hearts**
Failed To become stable: **+6 Hearts**

**Can You Boogey reds??? Yes but only If you are currently a Red, Or A Orange!**
**Direct Boogeys are the only way to get the death penalty** so if you die to a trap you will only receive -2 Hearts
___________
## **Secondary Twist: (Silent Life)**
**Tab List Is Off**
**Death Messages are off**
**And Final Deaths Do not announce Who Died.**
Chat Will Also Turn Of and On periodically - (Custom To Rebound Life)
—-
